text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her debut on the horizon, Tamamo Cross has motivation in spades.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And yet, her meal before the big race is a single, tiny box lunch. Will that really be enough to sustain her? Worry fills my mind as I send her off.
